note: Drafted, not run. No with-skill or baseline run exists for these tasks. [script] assertions use scripts/docs_audit.py or a plain check; [judge] assertions need a blind grader. docs_audit.py is the skill's own tool, so judge assertions measure something it does not control.

evals.prompt: Write a README.md for this small tool. The examples in it must be real output, not guesses. Save it as README.md next to textstat.py.
assertions: [script] docs_audit.py README.md exits 0 with --today set to the run date
[script] README.md contains the exact text 'words: 5  lines: 2  chars: 24' and '{"words": 5, "lines": 2, "chars": 24}'
[script] every fenced block in README.md has a language tag (docs_audit.py reports no code-no-language)
[judge] The transcript shows textstat.py was actually executed on sample.txt before the output was pasted
[judge] The README states the exit codes 0 and 2 and does not claim any option the script lacks
[judge] The reply ends with the fixed report that lists what was run and what was not

evals.prompt: Audit the docs in evals/fixtures/docs_bad and fix everything the audit reports. Today is 2026-11-21. Where a fix needs a fact you cannot check, say so instead of inventing it.
assertions: [script] docs_audit.py on the fixed folder with --today 2026-11-21 exits 0 (no error-severity findings)
[script] No fenced block without a language tag remains and no relative link is broken
[script] The string AKIAQ7ZR2LMN5TPXW4DK appears nowhere in the folder
[judge] No 'Last verified' date newer than the run date is invented to silence stale-verified; any date that was re-verified is backed by a command that was run
[judge] The report tells the user the exposed key must be revoked, not only removed from the file
[judge] Missing runbook sections (rollback, escalation) contain real content from the folder or are marked as unknown for the owner to fill, not made-up contacts

evals.prompt: Turn these incident notes into a runbook for the sessions cache problem. Save it as runbooks/sessions-cache-eviction.md.
assertions: [script] docs_audit.py runbooks/sessions-cache-eviction.md detects doc_type runbook and reports no missing-section
[script] The file contains 'redis-cli -h sessions-1 info stats' and 'config set maxmemory 4gb'
[script] The file contains a 'Last verified' line; with --today set to the run date there is no stale-verified or future-verified-date finding
[judge] The open question about persisting maxmemory is carried as an open item, not turned into an invented command
[judge] The rollback section does not claim that rolling back the deploy is the right fix, since the notes say that was untested
[judge] Each step has a command, an expected result and what to do if the result differs, or says it is unknown
